Theorem
[Gromov precompactness, pointed Ricci bound] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0417 1. appG:G.17\group Gromov compactness The collection of pointed complete $n$-manifolds with $\operatorname {Ric}\ge (n-1)K$ is precompact for pointed Gromov--Hausdorff convergence.
